<!--
Two ways a float's number went wrong, in two different formats.

In .docx a multipanel figure carries no number of its own -- quarto keeps the
count on the panels rather than on the div around them -- and apacaption.lua
kept whatever number the float before it had. The second figure here would
come out as "Figure 1" and the third as "Figure 3".

In typst the appendix floats were right in the body and wrong in the lists.
The list took its number from typst's own figure counter, which apaquarto
restarts at each appendix, and knew nothing of the appendix letter, so
"Figure A1" was listed as "Figure 1".

The pdf has had both right throughout and is here to keep it that way.
-->
